# ui::CommandRef

Header: `winui/ui/Command.hpp`.

What a control's `.command` field holds: a non-owning reference to a [ui::Command](command.md), written as the command itself (`.command = save`), or empty. Either end may go first: a CommandRef whose command was destroyed is empty, and the controls holding it act as if they had none.

It follows the [Command](command.md) object it was given. A copy of the command, or one it was moved into, starts with no refs.

## CommandRef

```cpp
CommandRef() noexcept = default
```

No command.

## CommandRef

```cpp
CommandRef(std::nullptr_t) noexcept
```

No command.

## CommandRef

```cpp
CommandRef(const Command& command) noexcept
```

A reference to `command`; implicit, so a field takes `.command = save`.

## CommandRef

```cpp
CommandRef(const CommandRef& other) noexcept
```

Another reference to the same command.

## operator=

```cpp
CommandRef& operator=(const CommandRef& other) noexcept
```

Points at `other`'s command instead.
